title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
authors: Di Wu; Hongwei Wang; Wenhao Yu; Yuwei Zhang; Kai-Wei Chang; Dong Yu
why_relevant: LongMemEval benchmarks long-term memory in chat assistants, including abstention on unanswerable questions and knowledge updates, which touch on calibration and conflict handling in retrieval-augmented memory systems.
